title: Portia Capture Batch
description: Version-1 non-domain Portia work root for one paper-assisted capture operation. A Capture Batch exists so Portia can prepare and route blank or partially prefilled paper without fabricating an Event, Account, Observation, Response, Communication, or other behavior-domain record before evidence exists.
$comment: The Capture Batch work_id is the identity used by Core work references for this operational workflow. Application validation remains responsible for Core class ownership, storage-path agreement, lifecycle transitions, authorization, and ensuring that opening or closing a Capture Batch does not itself create or assert behavior-domain facts.

x-portia-application-invariants.description: The Capture Batch must resolve at the canonical Portia work path for its exact class_id/work_id, and that class must be a legitimate Core-owned class context.

Creating, opening, closing, or cancelling a Capture Batch must not create or assert an Event, participant fact, Account, Observation, Response, Communication, Support, Implementation, Fidelity, Outcome, Reentry, Repair, or other behavior-domain fact.
Application logic must enforce authorized state transitions and must not use Capture Batch state as evidence that printing, return, interpretation, review, or canonical materialization occurred.

label.description: Optional human-facing label for locating the operational batch. It is not a behavior-domain assertion.
